subject: Replace master-reboot-down-after-period with primary-reboot-down-after-period in sentinel.conf (#647)
reason: The change is confined to Sentinel mode: sentinelHandleConfiguration (parsing the 'sentinel primary-reboot-down-after-period' directive at startup), sentinelSetCommand (SENTINEL SET), and rewriteConfigSentinelOption (CONFIG REWRITE in a Sentinel), plus a sentinel.conf comment and a Sentinel TCL test. No installed experiment or component can reach Sentinel mode: deployments and the private servers of valkey.action.commands/valkey.action.tools run valkey-server in normal or cluster mode only, with no way to pass --sentinel, and valkey-sentinel is not one of the four tools valkey.action.tools may
